'''Stydge''' was a [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] who worked as a security guard for the band [[Distraction]], along with his brothers [[Rydge]] and [[Xydge]]. When the band traveled to the [[Starship/Legends|ship]] ''[[Sleemo Poya Jeedai]]'' to perform at a concert, Stydge and his brothers accompanied them and met with some [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] who were providing additional security during the event. He and his brothers cooperated with them in investigating the threat posed to the event by [[Niklas Cories]].
